name: AI Engineering
description: Build intelligent applications and systems with LLMs, agents, and production deployment
learning_objectives: Implement prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation
Create agent systems and tool integration
Ensure AI application security and observability

modules.title: LLM Fundamentals
modules.description: Core concepts of large language models, prompting, and generation
modules.project: Build a small CLI or notebook workflow that sends versioned prompts to one LLM API, captures token usage and outputs, and compares at least three prompt variants on a fixed set of inputs.
objectives: Version and pin prompts as artifacts, not ad-hoc strings
Measure token use, latency and output quality side by side
Pick a prompt variant with written criteria, not vibes
project_deliverables: A repository with prompts stored as files, each with an id and version
A run log recording model, parameters, latency and token counts
A comparison table across at least three prompt variants
A short README stating the selection criterion and the winner
modules.instructions: Implement the prompt playground, keep model name and parameters identical across variants, and capture metrics for every run. Paste the report summary in your submission and explain the variant you would ship and why.

modules.title: LLM Application Engineering
modules.description: Building production LLM applications with routing, fallback, and validation
modules.project_title: LLM application with routing and fallback
modules.project: Build a small LLM-backed service (e.g. ticket triage) with a primary model, a fallback model, and a validation layer that rejects malformed or unsafe outputs before they reach the caller.
objectives: Route requests with explicit rules and log every decision
Fall back deterministically when the primary model fails validation
Validate structured output against a schema
project_deliverables: A service exposing one endpoint with schema-validated output
A routing log showing primary/fallback decisions
A validation report for a fixed input set
A README covering failure modes and limits
modules.instructions: Build the service with routing, fallback and validation. Exercise both paths with a fixed test set and include the routing log and validation report in your submission.

modules.title: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
modules.description: Retrieval, vector search, and RAG debugging
modules.project: Build a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline over a small document collection: chunking, embeddings, vector search, and answer generation with citations. Measure retrieval quality on a hand-labelled question set.
objectives: Chunk documents deliberately and record the chunking decision
Evaluate retrieval (hit rate@k) separately from answer quality
Generate answers with citations to source chunks
project_deliverables: A working ingest + query pipeline with a fixed document set
A retrieval evaluation (hit rate@5 or similar) on at least 15 questions
Answers with citations for the same question set
A README documenting chunk size, overlap and embedding model
modules.instructions: Build the ingest and query path, then measure retrieval quality on your question set. Submit the evaluation numbers, two example cited answers, and the chunking rationale.

modules.title: AI Agents
modules.description: Agent systems, tool integration, and orchestration
modules.project_title: Tool-using agent for a narrow job
modules.project: Build a single-purpose agent (e.g. release-note triage or expense extraction) that uses at least three tools, records every tool call as a trace, and stops safely when a tool fails.
objectives: Design tools with clear names, schemas and errors
Bound the agent loop (max steps, timeouts, cost cap)
Produce a readable execution trace per run
project_deliverables: An agent with at least three working tools and a bounded loop
Structured execution traces for at least five runs
A failure-injection test (tool errors do not crash or hang)
A README with the tool contracts and stop conditions
modules.instructions: Build the agent and its trace format. Run the failure-injection cases and include two full traces in your submission.

modules.title: Agent Orchestration
modules.project: Build a two- or three-agent workflow (e.g. drafter + reviewer, or researcher + writer) with explicit hand-offs, checkpoints and a single shared state object. Show what happens when one agent misbehaves.
objectives: Define agent roles, inputs and outputs as contracts
Persist workflow state so a run can resume from a checkpoint
Degrade gracefully when one agent fails
project_deliverables: A runnable workflow with at least two agents and explicit hand-offs
A checkpoint/resume demonstration (kill mid-run, resume)
An orchestrator log showing per-agent inputs and outputs
A README describing roles, contracts and failure handling
modules.instructions: Implement the workflow and its shared state. Demonstrate the checkpoint/resume path and include the kill/resume log in your submission.

modules.title: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
modules.description: Standardized context and provenance for LLM applications
modules.project: Build a small MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that exposes two or three tools to a host application, with explicit parameter schemas, provenance metadata on results, and a permission boundary.
objectives: Write an MCP server with validated tool schemas
Attach provenance to every tool result
Scope what the server can read and write
project_deliverables: A running MCP server with at least two tools
Tool schemas with validation and documented error cases
A client transcript showing calls and provenance metadata
A README covering the permission boundary and threat notes
modules.instructions: Implement the MCP server and at least one real client session. Include the transcript and the permission boundary documentation in your submission.

modules.title: Production AI Engineering
modules.description: Deployment, monitoring, and observability for AI systems
modules.project_title: Observable AI service in production shape
modules.project: Take a small LLM service and put it in production shape: structured logs, metrics (latency, error rate, token cost per request), alerts, and a written incident runbook. Deploy it and capture evidence.
objectives: Instrument the service: latency, errors, token cost
Alert on SLO breaches with a documented response
Prove deploy/rollback works on the target platform
project_deliverables: A deployed service with a public health endpoint
A dashboard or log extract showing latency/error/cost metrics
Alert rules with one triggered (or simulated) incident
A runbook: deploy, rotate, rollback, and escalate
modules.instructions: Deploy the instrumented service, trigger or simulate one alert, and submit the metrics extract plus the runbook.

modules.title: Docker & Deployment
modules.description: Containerization and deployment for AI workloads
modules.project: Containerize an AI workload (model server or agent) with a pinned, minimal image, a tested compose/k8s path, and CI that builds, scans and smoke-tests on every push.
objectives: Build a reproducible image: pinned base, lockfile, non-root user
Automate build + smoke test in CI
Measure image size and cold-start time
project_deliverables: A Dockerfile with pinned base image and non-root runtime
CI workflow: lint, build, vulnerability scan, smoke test
A measured cold-start and image size report
A README with the deploy command and rollback
modules.instructions: Containerize the workload and wire the CI pipeline. Include the image size/cold-start measurements and a green CI run URL in your submission.

modules.title: AI System Design
modules.description: End-to-end AI system architecture and decision records
modules.project: Write the system design for a real AI product slice: requirements, threat model, architecture diagram, capacity and cost estimate, rollout plan and rollback, and the decision record for two rejected alternatives.
objectives: Produce a defensible architecture with explicit trade-offs
Estimate latency, throughput and monthly cost
Write a threat model with mitigations
project_deliverables: An architecture document with diagram and data-flow
A capacity and monthly cost estimate with assumptions
A threat model with at least five threats and mitigations
A decision record for two rejected alternatives
modules.instructions: Write the design for one concrete AI product slice. Submit the architecture document, cost estimate and threat model; be explicit about what you would build first.
